quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #17
										  					
  

30 Questions • Passing Score 24

questions.question: If you stop along the road at night, what should you do?

options.text: Turn off all your lights.
Use your parking lights only.
Use your headlights only.
Turn on your emergency flashers and leave your low beams on.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on your emergency flashers and leave your low beams on.
questions.explanation: Turn on your emergency flashers and leave your low beam headlights on. Other drivers need to see your vehicle clearly.

questions.question: A driver entering traffic from a driveway or private road should:

options.text: Has the right-of-way.
Yield to drivers already on the public road.
Force their way into traffic.
Assume other drivers will make room for them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to drivers already on the public road.
questions.explanation: When entering traffic from a driveway or private road, yield to drivers on the public road. Merge safely when it is possible to do so.

questions.question: If another car is about to hit you, what should you do?

options.text: Sound your horn.
Wave your arms.
Use your emergency lights.
Flash your headlights.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sound your horn.
questions.explanation: Use your horn to warn other drivers or pedestrians who may not see you. Sound your horn if you think another driver is about to hit you.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Road construction ahead.
The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.
Steep grade ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead curves to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: When driving on wet pavement, remember:

options.text: Roads are especially slippery right when rain starts.
Wet roads can cause hydroplaning.
Allow extra space to stop.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Wet roads are very slippery, especially when rain just starts. Your tires lose grip on the layer of oil, dirt, and water. Slow down when there is heavy rain, standing water, or slush to avoid losing traction.

questions.question: Two solid yellow lines on the road mean:

options.text: Passing is allowed from both directions.
Passing is not allowed.
Passing is allowed at the top of a hill.
Passing is allowed during daylight only.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is not allowed.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines mean traffic on the other side is moving in the opposite direction. Never cross two solid yellow lines to pass from either direction.

questions.question: What does a single dashed white line between lanes mean?

options.text: You may pass even if it could be dangerous.
Lanes move in opposite directions.
You may not pass.
You may pass if it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may pass if it is safe.
questions.explanation: White lines separate lanes moving in the same direction. You may cross dashed white lines to pass or change lanes if it is safe to do so.

questions.question: You are driving forward out of your driveway. You:

options.text: Must come to a complete stop before crossing the sidewalk.
Must slow down before crossing the sidewalk.
Have the right-of-way over pedestrians on the sidewalk.
Can cross the sidewalk without stopping if you honk first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must come to a complete stop before crossing the sidewalk.
questions.explanation: Always come to a complete stop before crossing the sidewalk when leaving your driveway. You must stop before entering the road. Failing to stop is against the law.

questions.question: A police officer tells you to drive through a red light. What should you do?

options.text: Stop and then proceed.
Wait for the green light.
Follow the officer's direction.
Make a right turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow the officer's direction.
questions.explanation: You must follow all lawful directions from police officers. If an officer tells you to go through a red light, do what they instruct.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Your current road ends ahead.
You must turn right or left.
A four-way intersection is ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must turn either right or left.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow "X" over a traffic lane mean?

options.text: You must leave this lane. Oncoming traffic will use it soon.
You can drive normally in this lane.
This lane is for left turns only.
You can use this lane, but drive carefully.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must leave this lane. Oncoming traffic will use it soon.
questions.explanation: Lane control signals show which lanes are open or closed. They also show if toll booths are open. A solid yellow "X" means you must move out of that lane because oncoming traffic will use it soon.

questions.question: You see a stopped emergency vehicle with flashing lights. You must:

options.text: Slow down. Change lanes if you can so you do not drive next to the emergency vehicle.
Drive to the right side of the road and stop.
Stay in your lane and keep driving at the same speed.
Speed up and pass the stopped vehicle quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down. Change lanes if you can so you do not drive next to the emergency vehicle.
questions.explanation: When you see a stopped emergency vehicle with flashing lights, you must change lanes to give it space. If you cannot change lanes safely or if there is only one lane, slow down below the speed limit. Always be ready to stop at an emergency scene.

questions.question: When driving where children are playing, expect them to:

options.text: Know when it is safe to cross the street.
Stop at the curb before crossing the street.
Run out in front of you without looking.
Not cross the street unless an adult is with them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Run out in front of you without looking.
questions.explanation: Always drive slowly and carefully where children play. Children may not understand the danger and may run into the street without looking.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and get ready to stop if cars are coming.
Stop completely. Go when it is safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection. You do not always have to stop.
Stop only if traffic is on the crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely. Go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must stop completely. You must let vehicles and pedestrians in or near the intersection go first. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Low clearance.
Fines double in a work zone.
No left turn.
Do not block intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low clearance.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to road hazards ahead. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the clearance ahead is low.

questions.question: You can avoid crashes caused by alcohol by:

options.text: Deciding before you drink that you will not drive.
Saying "No thanks, I'm driving" if someone offers you a drink.
Calling a taxi.
Doing any of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Doing any of the above.
questions.explanation: The best way to avoid drunk driving crashes is to decide not to drive before you start drinking. Alcohol affects your judgment, making it harder to make safe choices after you drink.

questions.question: At a light rail crossing, you must always:

options.text: Look both ways before crossing the tracks.
Pay attention and obey all traffic signals.
Share the road with pedestrians and bicyclists.
Do all of these.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do all of these.
questions.explanation: Never drive around lowered crossing gates. Always look both ways before turning across train tracks. Always obey signs and traffic signals. Trains share the road with cars and bicyclists.

questions.question: A flashing red traffic signal works the same way as:

options.text: A slow sign.
A yield sign.
A stop sign.
An intersection sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: A stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red signal means you must stop and let all other traffic pass first.

questions.question: To prevent hydroplaning, you should:

options.text: Keep your tires in good condition with proper tread.
Keep your tires filled to the correct pressure.
Slow down when driving in the rain.
Do all of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do all of the above.
questions.explanation: To prevent hydroplaning, keep your tires in good condition with proper tread depth and correct air pressure. Slow down when driving in the rain. Hydroplaning happens most often at high speeds.

questions.question: You must yield to other drivers:

options.text: When entering a street from a garage or alley.
When they are on a road to your left and you reach an unmarked intersection at the same time.
When your traffic signal is a green arrow.
In all of the above cases.

questions.correctAnswerText: When entering a street from a garage or alley.
questions.explanation: You must yield to other drivers when entering a street from an alley, driveway, or garage. You must also yield to pedestrians on the sidewalk.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a flashing yellow light at an intersection?

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Continue normally through the intersection.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Stop and proceed when the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means caution. Slow down, look both ways, and proceed carefully through the intersection.

questions.question: When driving past a vehicle that just parked on the side of the road, what should you do?

options.text: Expect the driver to open the car door as you pass.
Speed up.
Slam on your brakes.
Assume the driver will wait for you to pass before opening the door.

questions.correctAnswerText: Expect the driver to open the car door as you pass.
questions.explanation: When passing a newly parked vehicle, be ready for the driver to open the door. Use extra caution when driving near parked cars.

questions.question: A fire engine is following you on a two-lane street without using its emergency lights or sirens. What should you do?

options.text: Drive normally.
Stop as quickly as you can.
Speed up to get out of the way.
Slow down, move to the right, and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive normally.
questions.explanation: If an emergency vehicle is not using its siren or flashing lights, you do not need to pull over. Continue driving normally.

questions.question: Compared to smaller vehicles, larger vehicles have:

options.text: Larger blind spots.
Smaller blind spots.
No blind spots.
The same blind spots as smaller vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Larger blind spots.
questions.explanation: Larger vehicles have larger blind spots. Large trucks and SUVs cannot see areas close to their rear in their mirrors.

questions.question: If two drivers reach an open intersection at the same time, who has the right-of-way?

options.text: The driver on the right.
The driver on the left.
One driver may continue driving without stopping.
One driver should honk to show they are giving up the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: The driver on the right.
questions.explanation: If a vehicle arrives at an open intersection at the same time as you, yield to the vehicle on your right. You can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What should you do if you have a tire blowout?

options.text: Take your foot off the gas.
Do not immediately use your brakes.
Gradually slow down and pull off the side of the road.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: During a tire blowout, release the gas pedal and avoid braking suddenly. Gradually slow down, then gently apply the brakes and pull to the side of the road.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign mean?

options.text: It warns you about road and traffic conditions ahead.
It shows directions to nearby cities and towns.
It explains traffic laws and rules.
It tells you about road construction.

questions.correctAnswerText: It warns you about road and traffic conditions ahead.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs with black symbols on a yellow background are warning signs. They alert you to conditions on or near the road.

questions.question: Roads freeze most quickly when they are:

options.text: Flat.
Curvy.
In the sun.
Shaded.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shaded.
questions.explanation: In cold or wet weather, shaded areas freeze faster than other parts of the road. These areas are also the last to dry. Be careful on roads shaded by trees or buildings.

questions.question: What should you do when driving in fog?

options.text: Drive slowly and carefully.
Do not use your high beam headlights.
Use low beam headlights to see the road better.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Fog reduces visibility. Drive slowly and carefully. Use low beams instead of high beams, as low beams work better in fog and won't reflect back at you.

questions.question: What does a solid red arrow in a traffic signal mean?

options.text: It is never used in traffic signals.
It means the same thing as a red circular light.
You may turn in the direction the arrow points.
Traffic must move in the direction the arrow points.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same thing as a red circular light.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow has the same meaning as a red circular light. You must stop and cannot turn in the direction the arrow points.
